directions.title: Software-defined & 5G networks
directions.description: Software-defined networking, virtualised network functions and open-source 5G testbeds. We study how network services can be deployed, measured and orchestrated.

directions.title: Intelligent network management
directions.description: Learning-based resource allocation, network slicing and service differentiation, including communication across terrestrial and non-terrestrial networks.
directions.alt: A network analyser measuring data transmission through a switch

directions.title: IoT & connected sensing
directions.description: Wireless sensor networks and connected applications for digital health and smart infrastructure, with machine learning for sensor data and dependable communication.
directions.alt: X-ray photograph of a heart-rate sensor circuit

directions.title: Secure cyber-physical systems
directions.description: Machine learning for intrusion and anomaly detection in industrial control systems, water distribution networks, microgrids and software-defined sensor networks.
directions.alt: Programmable logic controllers and network wiring in an industrial control panel
